analysis.title: UDR Inc. (UDR): 3Q26 First Take: Higher Repurchases, But Lower New Lease
key_insights: UDR reported official 3Q26 results after its 21 October preliminary release. Core FFO was $0.65, about 2% above GSe and Visible Alpha consensus of $0.64.

Same-store revenue grew +1.5% YoY including JV properties, above GSe at 1.2% and in line with consensus at 1.5%. Same-store expenses grew +2.7%, above GSe at 2.1% and in line with consensus at 2.7%. Same-store NOI grew +1.0%, in line with GSe at 1.0% and consensus at 0.9%.

3Q blended lease rate growth was 1.7% including JV properties (2.0% excluding), below GSe at 1.9% and consensus at 2.0%. Renewals were 4.1% excluding JV properties, above GSe at 3.8% and in line with consensus at 4.2%.

New lease rate growth was -1.2% excluding JV properties, worse than GSe at -1.0% and consensus at -0.6%. Blended spreads were 30bps lower including JV properties, so GS believes Apollo-inclusive new lease growth may have been weaker than -1.2%.
UDR closed the $2.0bn Apollo partnership, contributing 19 communities at a ~6.0% cap rate for $1.34bn of equity capital while retaining about one third ownership.

Management raised FY26 Core FFO guidance to $2.54-$2.56 ($2.55 midpoint, from $2.53), vs GSe at $2.52 and consensus at $2.54. 4Q Core FFO guidance is $0.64 at the midpoint, in line with GSe and consensus. Guidance is unchanged from the October preliminary results.

Same-store revenue, expense and NOI growth guidance midpoints were changed by +7.5bps, -35bps and +12.5bps to +1.45%, +2.9% and +0.75%, including the JV portfolio. GSe is at +1.4%/+2.8%/+0.9% and consensus at +1.5%/+3.1%/+0.7%.
UDR sold apartment communities in Seattle and Nashville in 3Q26: 412 apartments for $183mn.
UDR completed about $185mn of share repurchases from the end of July through October at an average price of $35.48 per share, vs GSe of $50mn in 3Q26 and 4Q26.
GS expects UDR to trade in line on Tuesday on the guidance increase, with softer new-lease growth shifting focus to blended spreads for 2027.

Questions for the call: blends and new leases in 4Q, new lease trends including JV assets, 2027 earn-in, Apollo JV details (including whether Apollo has a put option), and concession trends in 3Q and 4Q quarter-to-date.

market_movers.rationale: Price target maintained at $35, based on a Q5-Q8 FFO multiple of 13.3x. Stock closed at $35.91 on 2 Nov, implying 2.5% downside.

earnings_insights: UDR 3Q26 Core FFO per share $0.65 (reported, pre-released 21 Oct) vs GSe $0.64 and Visible Alpha consensus $0.64, a 1.9% beat vs GSe.
UDR 3Q26 FFO per share (diluted) $0.62 reported vs GSe $0.63 (-1.4%) and consensus $0.64.
UDR 3Q26 occupancy 96.6% vs GSe 96.4% and consensus 96.5%.
UDR FY26 Core FFO guidance $2.54-$2.56 (midpoint $2.55, previously $2.53) vs GSe $2.52 and consensus $2.54. 4Q26 Core FFO guidance midpoint $0.64 vs GSe and consensus $0.64.
risk_factors: Upside risks to the Sell rating: improvement in demand, higher acquisition and development volumes or yields, lower property operating expenses, and an improved cost of capital.
New lease rate growth missed estimates and may be weaker once Apollo JV properties are included.
